title: Clarify LIMR scope, name, governance and consumer notification
requirements:
- Require release and deprecation notifications to registered consumers
- Identify the LIMR as a proposed capability and distinguish established practice from novel consolidation
- Federate only from published, versioned package channels and monitor publication-pipeline health
- Require multidisciplinary domain review of models
- Define whether it governs logical models only or also implementation artefacts
- State that governance is required from the outset while tooling matures
